column1: # Mounted read-only into the container at /etc/nornir-net-mounts/nas-mounts.tsv.
# TAB-separated columns:  fstype <TAB> source <TAB> target <TAB> options
#   fstype  : cifs | nfs4 (any fs whose driver is loaded in the shared WSL2 kernel)
#   target  : absolute mount point inside the container
#   options : comma-separated mount -o options; uid/gid are appended automatically.
#             CIFS lines reference a credentials file in the SEPARATE secrets bind
#             at /run/secrets/net-creds/<id>.cred (no secret material lives in this file).
